The Flow Notifications app adds a **Send a notification** action to Nextcloud Flow. It automates generating customized notifications for events that match configured rules.

Choose an event and conditions, and optionally provide a title prefix to help identify the resulting notification.

## How it works

When personal flows are enabled, users can configure notification rules in their personal Flow settings.

Each rule group combines its conditions with AND: the group matches only when all its conditions match. Each matching group can trigger a notification. Events include file activity and tag assignment; conditions include MIME type, time ranges, upload size, and more.

For example, configure a flow for the **File updated** event with a MIME type condition of `application/pdf` and the optional title "PDF updated". When another user updates a matching PDF you can access, your flow can notify you.

## Considerations

* Notifications are skipped when the current session user is the flow owner. For example, updating a file in your own session will not notify you through your own flow.
* Ensure that the [Notifications](https://github.com/nextcloud/notifications) app is installed and enabled. It is required for Flow Notifications to register its action.
* The notification action is available for personal flows, not administrator-scoped flows.

For general configuration guidance, see the [Nextcloud Flow documentation](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/stable/go.php?to=admin-workflowengine). Discover more about Nextcloud Flow at [https://nextcloud.com/workflow](https://nextcloud.com/workflow).

translations.Enable users to configure notifications:
Enable users to configure notifications with customized conditions in their Flow configuration.

Users are empowered to configure a "Send a notification" Flow in their personal settings. They can choose between the events being triggered, and other conditions like filetypes, assigned tags, time ranges and more. They can specify an inscription so that when the notification appears they will have context.

To use the `Flow Notifications` app, ensure that the `Notifications` app is installed and enabled. The `Notifications` app provides the necessary APIs for the `Flow Notifications` app to work correctly.

![Notification Flow Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/flow_notifications/master/screenshots/configuration.png)

When an event happens where all conditions are apply, the user will receive a regular Nextcloud notification.

![Flow Notification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/flow_notifications/master/screenshots/notification.png)
